project_phase: Phase 2 complete. Phase 5 (durable runtime): NEX-001..NEX-036 all VERIFIED. NEX-036 audited the decisioning path's production caller. The fail-closed premise held - a pending request stays `pending` after an advisory, and abstentions (DISABLED / PROVIDER_ERROR / MALFORMED_OUTPUT) reach the caller rather than being swallowed - but the audit found a real contract defect: RecommendApprovalDecision produced advice for requests already approved, denied or revoked, contradicting its own docstring. Fixed with a status/liveness guard returning 409.
